items.title: Suspect in deadly Paris suburb shooting sent for psychiatric observation

sentences.en: Suspect in deadly Paris suburb shooting sent for psychiatric observation.
sentences.zh: 巴黎郊区枪击事件的嫌疑人被派去接受精神病观察。

sentences.en: He will be observed to evaluate whether his "psychiatric health is compatible with pursuing his interrogation", authorities said.
sentences.zh: 当局表示，将对他进行观察，以评估他的“精神健康状况是否与继续审讯一致”。

items.title: Portuguese police with dogs and batons dismantle housing protest camps

sentences.en: Portuguese police with dogs and batons dismantle housing protest camps.
sentences.zh: 带着狗和警棍的葡萄牙警察拆除了抗议营地的房屋。

sentences.en: More than 30 people arrested as officers clear at least 100 tents in central Lisbon and about 50 in Porto Police in Portugal have dismantled housing protest camps in Lisbon and Porto, baton-charging campaigners in the early hours of Sunday and arresting more than 30 people.
sentences.zh: 警方在里斯本市中心清理了至少100顶帐篷，葡萄牙波尔图警察局约有50人拆除了里斯本和波尔图的抗议营地，警棍在周日凌晨对活动人士充电，并逮捕了30多人。

sentences.en: The raids were the latest incident in days of clashes between police and campaigners who – inspired by similar camps in Spain – had sought to pitch tents in central squares to protest against the country’s deepening housing crisis.
sentences.zh: 这次袭击是警方和活动人士之间发生冲突的最新事件，他们受到西班牙类似难民营的启发，试图在中央广场搭建帐篷，以抗议该国不断加深的住房危机。

items.title: Brazilians vote in presidential election runoff pitting leftist Lula against far-right Bolsonaro

sentences.en: Brazilians vote in presidential election runoff pitting leftist Lula against far-right Bolsonaro.
sentences.zh: 巴西人在总统选举决选中投票，左翼卢拉对阵极右翼博尔索纳罗。

sentences.en: Incumbent president lost in first round to senator and son of convicted ex-president Brazilians are going to the polls on Sunday in a highly unpredictable runoff in which the leftist president, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva , is attempting an unprecedented comeback against the far-right senator Flávio Bolsonaro , who won the first-round vote.
sentences.zh: 现任总统在第一轮投票中输给了参议员和被定罪的前总统巴西人的儿子，他们将于周日参加民意调查，这是一个非常不可预测的决定，左翼总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦(Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva)正试图对赢得第一轮投票的极右翼参议员弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗(Flávio Bolsonaro)进行前所未有的反击。

sentences.en: Bolsonaro’s surprise victory despite not leading most polls made him the favourite three weeks ago, but since then Lula’s campaign has gained ground, and the two go into the contest virtually tied.
sentences.zh: 尽管在大多数民意调查中没有领先，但博尔索纳罗的惊人胜利使他成为三周前最受欢迎的人选，但从那时起，卢拉的竞选活动已经取得了进展，两人几乎并驾齐驱。

items.title: Gabon says access to social media restored after eight-month ban

sentences.en: Gabon says access to social media restored after eight-month ban.
sentences.zh: 加蓬表示，在8个月的禁令后，社交媒体的访问权限得以恢复。

sentences.en: The authorities had justified the ban by saying online content was fuelling conflict, while the opposition had condemned it as an abuse of power.
sentences.zh: 当局为禁令辩护，称在线内容助长了冲突，而反对派则谴责这是滥用权力。

items.title: Volkswagen to build $4bn Audi SUV factory in US despite job cuts at home

sentences.en: Volkswagen to build $4bn Audi SUV factory in US despite job cuts at home.
sentences.zh: 大众汽车将在美国建造价值40 $的奥迪SUV工厂，尽管国内裁员。

sentences.en: VW investment, creating 4,500 jobs in Georgia, comes amid Trump’s damaging tariffs, intense Chinese competition and costly shift towards EVs Audi has said it will spend $4bn (£3bn) to build its first factory in the US, as its parent company, Volkswagen, struggles with the impact of steep tariffs imposed by Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 大众投资在格鲁吉亚创造了4500个工作岗位，而特朗普的破坏性关税、激烈的中国竞争和昂贵的电动汽车转向奥迪表示，它将斥资40亿美元（ 30亿英镑）在美国建造第一家工厂，因为其母公司大众汽车(Volkswagen)正在努力应对唐纳德·特朗普(Donald Trump)征收高额关税的影响。

sentences.en: The German brand’s chief executive, Gernot Döllner, joined Trump on stage at a campaign rally on Saturday night to announce the factory in Macon, Georgia, in an unusual move by a big European brand just days before the US midterm elections.
sentences.zh: 这家德国品牌的首席执行官格诺特·多尔纳（ Gernot Döllner ）在周六晚上的竞选集会上与特朗普一起宣布在佐治亚州梅肯建厂，这是一家欧洲大品牌在美国中期选举前几天采取的不寻常举措。

items.title: Why do planes keep circling before landing? The UN has a plan to fix it

sentences.en: Why do planes keep circling before landing?
sentences.zh: 为什么飞机在降落前一直盘旋？

sentences.en: The UN has a plan to fix it.
sentences.zh: 联合国有一个解决这个问题的计划。

sentences.en: Air traffic delays cost billions and turn journeys into ordeals.
sentences.zh: 空中交通延误造成数十亿美元的损失，并将旅程变成考验。

sentences.en: Some countries are already proving that better coordination saves thousands of flying hours and cuts emissions – and the UN’s aviation agency wants the rest of the world to follow.
sentences.zh: 一些国家已经证明，更好的协调可以节省数千小时的飞行时间并减少排放，联合国航空机构希望世界其他国家也能效仿。

items.title: Signs suggest Thomas Markle Sr may be ‘sex offender of the grossest kind’, says Philippine minister

sentences.en: Signs suggest Thomas Markle Sr may be ‘sex offender of the grossest kind’, says Philippine minister.
sentences.zh: 菲律宾部长表示，有迹象表明Thomas Markle Sr可能是“最严重的性犯罪者”。

sentences.en: Exclusive: Forensic analysis of found images continues as Meghan’s father denies possessing child sexual abuse images All signs point to Thomas Markle Sr being a “possible sex offender of the grossest kind” although a full forensic investigation will give a “definitive picture”, the Philippine interior minister has told the Guardian.
sentences.zh: 独家：尽管全面的法医调查将给出一个“明确的画面” ，但由于Meghan的父亲否认拥有儿童性虐待图像，法医分析仍在继续。所有迹象都表明Thomas Markle Sr是“最严重的可能的性犯罪者” ，菲律宾内政部长告诉卫报。

sentences.en: Authorities in the south-east Asian country are analysing digital images allegedly belonging to the estranged father of the Duchess of Sussex that were said to have been found at his former home in Cebu.
sentences.zh: 这个东南亚国家的当局正在分析据称属于苏塞克斯公爵夫人疏远的父亲的数字图像，据说这些图像是在宿务公爵夫人以前的家中发现的。

sentences.en: Meghan’s half-brother, Thomas Markle Jr, reported to authorities last week that he had apparently discovered a stash of child sexual abuse images.
sentences.zh: 梅根的同父异母兄弟小托马斯·马克尔（ Thomas Markle Jr ）上周向当局报告说，他显然发现了一些儿童性虐待图像。

items.title: This College of Magic turns ordinary kids into cool magicians

sentences.en: This College of Magic turns ordinary kids into cool magicians.
sentences.zh: 这所魔法学院将普通的孩子变成了很酷的魔术师。

sentences.en: The students, many from marginalized communities, learn to conjure up candy, do card tricks — and face the world with a confident, creative and resilient mindset.
sentences.zh: 许多学生来自边缘化社区，他们学会了制作糖果、玩纸牌把戏，并以自信、创造性和韧性的心态面对世界。

items.title: El Salvador president says bodies found in Haiti are not those of hostages

sentences.en: El Salvador president says bodies found in Haiti are not those of hostages.
sentences.zh: 萨尔瓦多总统说，在海地发现的尸体不是人质。

sentences.en: Nayib Bukele says bodies delivered to soldiers are "not our men" amid search for Salvadorans abducted last week.
sentences.zh: 纳伊布·布克莱（ Nayib Bukele ）表示，在搜寻上周被绑架的萨尔瓦多人时，运送给士兵的尸体“不是我们的人”。

items.title: More than 1,300 arrested as clashes follow another day of mass protests across France

sentences.en: More than 1,300 arrested as clashes follow another day of mass protests across France.
sentences.zh: 在法国又一天的大规模抗议活动之后，有1300多人因冲突而被捕。

sentences.en: Hundreds of thousands took part in demonstrations in France, with protests also taking place in other European countries.
sentences.zh: 数十万人参加了法国的示威活动，其他欧洲国家也发生了抗议活动。

items.title: When a teen posts a selfie, how much filter is 'too much' filter?

sentences.en: When a teen posts a selfie, how much filter is 'too much' filter?.
sentences.zh: 当青少年发布自拍照时， “过多”筛选条件是多少？。

sentences.en: The recent Meta settlement includes a clause banning "cosmetic procedure filters" for teens.
sentences.zh: 最近的Meta和解包括一项禁止青少年使用“整容程序过滤器”的条款。

sentences.en: But defining what constitutes an extreme makeover isn't easy.
sentences.zh: 但是，定义什么是极端改造并不容易。

items.title: Independent candidates sense a moment. Some Democrats hope they're right.

sentences.en: Independent candidates sense a moment.
sentences.zh: 独立候选人能感受到一瞬间。

sentences.en: Some Democrats hope they're right.
sentences.zh: 一些民主党人希望他们是对的。

sentences.en: As they look to win the Senate, Democrats are hoping that independent candidates in Nebraska and Montana can help them topple Republicans in a part of the country where their own brand is hurting.
sentences.zh: 在他们希望赢得参议院的同时，民主党人希望内布拉斯加州和蒙大拿州的独立候选人能够帮助他们在自己品牌受到伤害的部分地区推翻共和党人。

items.title: More dads taking paid family leave for a new baby, sometimes as much as moms are

sentences.en: More dads taking paid family leave for a new baby, sometimes as much as moms are.
sentences.zh: 更多的爸爸为新生儿休带薪家庭假，有时和妈妈一样多。

sentences.en: The U.S. has no national law for paid parental leave.
sentences.zh: 美国没有关于带薪育儿假的国家法律。

sentences.en: But in states that do, more dads are using the benefit, sometimes more than moms.
sentences.zh: 但在这样做的州，更多的爸爸正在使用这种福利，有时甚至超过妈妈。

sentences.en: The change comes as Americans say having kids is unaffordable.
sentences.zh: 这一变化发生之际，美国人说生孩子是负担不起的。

items.title: Musk says SpaceX restricted Ukraine's Starlink connection as service restored

sentences.zh: 马斯克表示，随着服务的恢复， SpaceX限制了乌克兰的Starlink连接。

sentences.en: The tech billionaire accuses Ukraine of violating its terms of service by using the network for military activity.
sentences.zh: 这位科技亿万富翁指责乌克兰违反其服务条款，将该网络用于军事活动。

items.title: Israeli soldiers raze neighbourhood in Hebron, driving families from homes

sentences.en: Israeli soldiers raze neighbourhood in Hebron, driving families from homes.
sentences.zh: 以色列士兵将希伯伦的居民区夷为平地，将家庭赶出家园。

sentences.en: PM Benjamin Netanyahu vows ‘to destroy this place’ in retaliation for militant attack on army checkpoint Israeli troops have levelled a neighbourhood in Hebron, driving out hundreds of families in collective punishment for a militant attack on an army checkpoint outside the West Bank city, local Palestinian authorities said.
sentences.zh: 巴勒斯坦地方当局表示，以色列总理本雅明·内塔尼亚胡（ Benjamin Netanyahu ）发誓要“摧毁这个地方” ，以报复武装分子对军队检查站的袭击。以色列军队夷平了希伯伦的一个街区，驱逐了数百个家庭，以集体惩罚武装分子袭击约旦河西岸城市外的一个军队检查站。

sentences.en: The Hebron municipality estimated that 35 hectares (86 acres) had been destroyed or marked for destruction and about 1,500 people had been evicted from their homes by Saturday afternoon in the district of Ein Deir Baha.
sentences.zh: 希伯伦市政府估计，截至周六下午， Ein Deir Baha区的35公顷（ 86英亩）土地已被摧毁或标记为要毁坏，约有1,500人被赶出家园。

sentences.en: The whole city of 250,000 people was sealed off by checkpoints on every point of entry.
sentences.zh: 整个城市的25万人被每个入境点的检查站封锁。

sentences.zh: 继续阅读

items.title: ‘Gaza’s suffering has become campaign fodder’: Palestinians fear the worst from Israel election

sentences.en: ‘Gaza’s suffering has become campaign fodder’: Palestinians fear the worst from Israel election.
sentences.zh: “加沙的苦难已成为竞选活动的素材” ：巴勒斯坦人担心以色列选举带来的最坏结果。

sentences.en: Humanitarian catastrophe largely ignored as rivals Gadi Eisenkot and Benjamin Netanyahu vow to end Hamas rule As Israel prepares to go to the polls , Palestinians in Gaza are bracing for an outcome that could shape their future, knowing their fate rests with the country that has reduced much of the territory to rubble and killed nearly 75,000 people.
sentences.zh: 由于竞争对手加迪·艾森科特（ Gadi Eisenkot ）和本雅明·内塔尼亚胡（ Benjamin Netanyahu ）发誓要结束哈马斯的统治，人道主义灾难在很大程度上被忽视。在以色列准备参加民意调查之际，加沙的巴勒斯坦人正在为可能塑造他们未来的结果做准备，因为他们知道他们的命运掌握在这个国家手中，这个国家已经将大部分领土夷为平地，造成近75,000人死亡。

sentences.en: Gaza, where nearly a million displaced Palestinians face dire sanitary conditions, water shortages and the constant threat of Israeli strikes, has been largely absent from the election campaign .
sentences.zh: 加沙有近100万流离失所的巴勒斯坦人面临严峻的卫生条件、水资源短缺和以色列罢工的持续威胁，竞选活动基本上没有参加。

sentences.en: Continue reading..
sentences.zh: 继续阅读

items.title: ‘That’s the way the city works’: how the UAE changed the face of Andy Burnham’s Manchester

sentences.en: ‘That’s the way the city works’: how the UAE changed the face of Andy Burnham’s Manchester.
sentences.zh: “这就是城市的运作方式” ：阿联酋如何改变安迪·伯纳姆（ Andy Burnham ）的曼彻斯特面貌。

sentences.en: The story of the emirates’ presence in Manchester winds from the Arab Spring to some of the most deprived places in England – with complicated results Emirati-linked firms’ ownership of Manchester land ‘up 39%’ in 10 years When Hosni Mubarak, Egypt’s long-ruling dictator, was toppled from power in the Arab spring protests of 2011, his downfall sent shock waves across the Middle East.
sentences.zh: 从阿拉伯之春到英格兰一些最贫困的地方，阿联酋在曼彻斯特的存在带来了复杂的结果--与阿联酋有关的公司对曼彻斯特土地的所有权在10年内“上涨了39%”。当埃及长期执政的独裁者胡斯尼·穆巴拉克在2011年的阿拉伯之春抗议活动中被推翻时，他的垮台给整个中东地区带来了冲击波。

sentences.en: It also helped change the face of modern Manchester.
sentences.zh: 它也有助于改变现代曼彻斯特的面貌。

sentences.en: Mubarak’s successor, the Muslim Brotherhood leader Mohamed Morsi, was a sworn enemy of the United Arab Emirates, whose rulers feared the advance of Morsi’s Islamism.
sentences.zh: 穆巴拉克的继任者，穆斯林兄弟会领导人穆罕默德·穆尔西（ Mohamed Morsi ）是阿拉伯联合酋长国的死敌，阿联酋的统治者担心穆尔西的伊斯兰主义会向前推进。

sentences.en: Continue reading..

sentences.zh: 以色列国防军宣布在周二选举前限制巴勒斯坦工人的行动。

items.title: Obama attacks Trump as he campaigns for Democrats ahead of midterm elections

sentences.en: Obama attacks Trump as he campaigns for Democrats ahead of midterm elections.
sentences.zh: 奥巴马在中期选举之前竞选民主党人时攻击特朗普。

sentences.en: Obama said the election was "the last best chance to at least rein in some of the foolishness of this administration".
sentences.zh: 奥巴马表示，这次选举是“至少遏制本届政府一些愚蠢行为的最后一次最佳机会”。

items.title: Myanmar’s Aung San Suu Kyi ‘sounds strong’ but is isolated, son says

sentences.en: Myanmar’s Aung San Suu Kyi ‘sounds strong’ but is isolated, son says.
sentences.zh: 儿子说，缅甸的昂山素季“听起来很强大” ，但却与世隔绝。

sentences.en: Kim Aris tells the Guardian chance to speak with detained Nobel laureate was ‘public relations’ move from military leaders Myanmar’s former democratic leader Aung San Suu Kyi appears to be in good physical and mental health but is living in near-complete isolation, her son has said after the first call with his 81-year-old mother in more than five years.
sentences.zh: 金·阿里斯（ Kim Aris ）告诉《卫报》，与被拘留的诺贝尔奖获得者交谈的机会是缅甸前民主领袖昂山素季（ Aung San Suu Kyi ）军事领导人的“公关”举动似乎身心健康状况良好，但生活在近乎完全的孤立中，她的儿子在与他81岁的母亲首次通话五年多后表示。

sentences.en: “She still sounds certainly all there mentally, and physically she sounds strong,” Kim Aris said.
sentences.zh: 金·阿里斯（ Kim Aris ）说： “她仍然在精神上听起来很强壮，身体上听起来也很强壮。”

sentences.en: “I don’t think she has anybody outside of the military or the police around her, so essentially she’s been held in solitary confinement from what I gather.” Continue reading..
sentences.zh: “我认为她周围没有军队或警察以外的任何人，所以基本上她被单独监禁。”继续阅读。

items.title: Vanessa Trump says she is cancer-free six months after revealing diagnosis

sentences.en: Vanessa Trump says she is cancer-free six months after revealing diagnosis.
sentences.zh: 凡妮莎·特朗普（ Vanessa Trump ）说，在透露诊断结果六个月后，她

sentences.en: The ex-wife of Donald Trump Jr, with whom she shares five children, announced in May that she had been diagnosed with breast cancer.
sentences.zh: 小唐纳德·特朗普（ Donald Trump Jr ）的前妻与她有五个孩子，她在5月份宣布她被诊断出患有乳腺癌。
